CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.garmon_date_utc(ts timestamp with time zone)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_referral_count()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.referred_by_code IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE users
    SET total_referrals = total_referrals + 1
    WHERE referral_code = NEW.referred_by_code;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  new_referral_code text;
BEGIN
  new_referral_code := upper(substring(
    replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''),
    1, 8
  ));

  WHILE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE referral_code = new_referral_code
  ) LOOP
    new_referral_code := upper(substring(
      replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''),
      1, 8
    ));
  END LOOP;

  INSERT INTO public.users (
    id,
    email,
    full_name,
    avatar_url,
    referral_code,
    balance,
    balance_cents,
    membership,
    role,
    is_super_admin,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url', ''),
    new_referral_code,
    0,
    0,
    'free',
    'user',
    false,
    now(),
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

  INSERT INTO public.wallet_balances (user_id, balance, updated_at)
  VALUES (new.id, 0, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coin_transactions WHERE reference = 'signup_bonus_' || new.id::text
  ) THEN
    PERFORM public.credit_coins(new.id, 0, 100);

    INSERT INTO public.coin_transactions (user_id, type, gold_coins, sweeps_coins, description, reference)
    VALUES (
      new.id,
      'signup_bonus',
      0,
      100,
      'Welcome bonus - 100 GPay Coins',
      'signup_bonus_' || new.id::text
    )
    ON CONFLICT (reference) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  RETURN new;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RAISE LOG 'handle_new_user error for user %: %', new.id, SQLERRM;
    RETURN new;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_daily_profit_summary()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.daily_profit_summary (date, advertiser_revenue_cents, member_payouts_cents, deferred_payouts_cents)
  VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, 0, 0, 0)
  ON CONFLICT (date) DO NOTHING;

  IF NEW.type IN ('deposit', 'advertiser_payment') AND NEW.status = 'completed' THEN
    UPDATE public.daily_profit_summary
    SET advertiser_revenue_cents = advertiser_revenue_cents + NEW.amount_cents,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE date = CURRENT_DATE;

  ELSIF NEW.type IN ('ad_view', 'task_complete', 'game_reward', 'referral_upgrade') AND NEW.status = 'completed' THEN
    UPDATE public.daily_profit_summary
    SET member_payouts_cents = member_payouts_cents + NEW.amount_cents,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE date = CURRENT_DATE;

  ELSIF NEW.status = 'deferred' THEN
    UPDATE public.daily_profit_summary
    SET deferred_payouts_cents = deferred_payouts_cents + NEW.amount_cents,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE date = CURRENT_DATE;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.celo_bump_room_total_rounds()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
     AND NEW.status = 'completed'
     AND (OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed') THEN
    UPDATE public.celo_rooms
    SET total_rounds = COALESCE(total_rounds, 0) + 1
    WHERE id = NEW.room_id;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_auth_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  new_referral_code text;
begin
  new_referral_code := 'GP' || upper(substr(md5(random()::text), 1, 6));
  insert into public.users (id, email, referral_code)
  values (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    new_referral_code
  )
  on conflict (id) do update set
    email = excluded.email,
    updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$function$

AS $function$

    SET
      balance       = NEW.balance,
      balance_cents = NEW.balance::integer,
      updated_at    = now()
    WHERE id = NEW.user_id;

  RETURN NEW;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.garmon_margin_last_24h()
 RETURNS TABLE(revenue_cents bigint, payout_cents bigint, margin_pct numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_revenue bigint;
  v_payout bigint;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0)::bigint
    INTO v_revenue
  FROM platform_earnings
  WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours';

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(delta_available_minor), 0)::bigint
    INTO v_payout
  FROM gpay_ledger
  WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
    AND delta_available_minor > 0;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT
    v_revenue,
    v_payout,
    CASE
      WHEN v_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ROUND(((v_revenue - v_payout)::numeric / v_revenue::numeric) * 100, 2)
    END;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.garmondrop_has_winner(g jsonb, pr integer, pc integer, val integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF val <> 1 AND val <> 2 THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  RETURN
    public.garmondrop_count_dir(g, pr, pc, val, 0, 1) + public.garmondrop_count_dir(g, pr, pc, val, 0, -1) - 1 >= 4
    OR public.garmondrop_count_dir(g, pr, pc, val, 1, 0) + public.garmondrop_count_dir(g, pr, pc, val, -1, 0) - 1 >= 4
    OR public.garmondrop_count_dir(g, pr, pc, val, 1, 1) + public.garmondrop_count_dir(g, pr, pc, val, -1, -1) - 1 >= 4
    OR public.garmondrop_count_dir(g, pr, pc, val, 1, -1) + public.garmondrop_count_dir(g, pr, pc, val, -1, 1) - 1 >= 4;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_deposit(p_user_id uuid, p_amount numeric)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin

  update wallet
  set balance = balance + p_amount,
      updated_at = now()
  where user_id = p_user_id;

  insert into transactions (
    user_id,
    amount,
    type
  )
  values (
    p_user_id,
    p_amount,
    'deposit'
  );

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.request_withdrawal(p_user_id uuid, p_amount numeric)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin

  update wallet
  set balance = balance - p_amount
  where user_id = p_user_id;

  insert into withdrawals (
    user_id,
    amount,
    status
  )
  values (
    p_user_id,
    p_amount,
    'pending'
  );

end;
$function$
